text:
Maria L: Heads up — nightly netsuite sync failed for batch 2026-03-22 00:00 UTC. Job crashed on invoice create. Error: 500 InternalServerError from NetSuite API. stack: Error: line amount must be > 0 (invoice id 68231)

AJ: invoice id?

Maria L: 68231
Logs:
```
2026-03-22T00:12:03Z ERROR sync-job: failed to create invoice 68231 - NetSuite 500 - validation error: 'line[0].amount' = 0.00
payload: {"customer": "cust_abc", "lines": [{"desc":"discount", "amount":0.00, "type":"credit"}], ...}
```

Samir: :eyes: That zero-amount credit line is coming from our Stripe -> usage export where we annotate promo refunds as 0 lines. We should skip lines with amount == 0 before calling NS.

Erin: If we just skip them, will DLQ replayer create dup credit memos later? We need idempotency.

AJ: Good point. Current replayer doesn't set an idempotency_key for credit memos. If we reprocess, netsuite will create duplicate credit memos. Need two-step: (1) webhook/transform skip zero lines; (2) add idempotency_key -> externalId on NS create for replays.

billing-bot: ALERT: nightly-sync job failed (job_id=ns-sync-20260322-01) — 1 failure. https://infra.redwood.example/alerts/12345

Maria L: I'll push a small hotfix to staging: transform in billing-export to filter zero lines + set externalId = stripe_invoice_id if present. Will run staging job to confirm.

Samir: Patch snippet:
```
// skip zero lines
payload.lines = payload.lines.filter(l => Math.abs(Number(l.amount)) > 0.0001)
// set external id
payload.externalId = payload.externalId || `stripe-${payload.metadata.stripe_invoice}`
```

Ken: Can someone open a finance ticket for backfill & manual reconciliation query? Need to find invoices that failed since 2026-03-15.

Erin: I'll run a query after staging green. SQL to find affected:
```
select id, stripe_invoice, created_at from stripe_exports
where exists (select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(lines) l where (l->>'amount')::numeric = 0)
and created_at >= '2026-03-15';
```

AJ: Also add a one-off job to requeue failed payloads but dedupe by externalId.

Maria L: Created ticket FIN-7892. Assigning to @Ken and @Samir. Will post staging run results shortly. :thumbsup:

Ken: :shipit:
